summary: A resident in {place} wants the address of a pass counter they can reach before trying to board with cash.
realLife: RideKC removed cash payment from buses and directed passengers without a smartphone or bank card to physical passes sold at specified locations.
gates: The dated agency guidance identifies the onboard payment rule and an actual pass sales point.
inGame: needs: the dated agency guidance identifies the onboard payment rule and an actual pass sales point.

turns.pulledBy: The listed sales point is operating.
turns.what: Give the rider the current location and hours if verified.
turns.writesBack: Record the source of the referral.

turns.pulledBy: The listed counter cannot be confirmed.
turns.what: Ask the transit agency for another sales point.
turns.writesBack: Leave access unresolved until one is identified.
